title: 深豎井襯砌施工
summary: 深豎井襯砌同時受到地層卸載、地下水、施工分段與長期材料變形影響。本課從有效應力及環向受壓開始，逐步區分厚壁分析、垂直承載、止水細部及背填空隙造成的彎曲，最後建立水位回復與裂縫變化的交接證據。
summaryEn: Deep-shaft linings respond to ground unloading, groundwater, construction lifts and long-term material deformation. The course separates effective stress and ring compression from thick-wall analysis, vertical load transfer, waterstop behaviour and bending over backfill voids, then builds evidence for groundwater recovery and crack monitoring.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：同一方向總應力假設為900 kPa，孔隙水壓為300 kPa，骨架有效應力為σ′=900−300=600 kPa。若只把孔壓提高10%至330 kPa，而總應力保持不變，σ′變為570 kPa，降低30 kPa亦即5%。這個比較只適用於相同位置、方向及總應力邊界；它不表示襯砌所受外水壓減少，相反水壓需求可能增加。工程師應分別把骨架強度與襯砌水壓作用帶回各自模型，並用分層水壓資料確認假設。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume total stress of 900 kPa and pore pressure of 300 kPa in the same direction, giving skeleton effective stress σ′=900−300=600 kPa. Increase only pore pressure by 10% to 330 kPa while holding total stress fixed: σ′ becomes 570 kPa, a reduction of 30 kPa or 5%. This comparison requires the same location, direction and total-stress boundary. It does not reduce external water pressure on the lining; hydraulic demand may instead rise. Check skeleton strength and lining pressure in their respective models and verify the assumptions using aquifer-specific piezometer data.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「有效應力的機理與驗證」與「環向壓力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective stress mechanism and verification" and "Hoop compression mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 有效應力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective stress mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效應力」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開挖降低井壁側向拘束，土骨架與孔隙水卻不是同一條荷載路徑。有效應力決定摩擦強度及變形，水壓另對不透水襯砌施力；因此從總應力扣去孔壓後，不能在襯砌設計中再把水力作用刪除。施工抽水與長期回復需分成不同階段，並核對應力方向及量測深度是否一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavation removes lateral confinement, but the soil skeleton and pore water follow different load paths. Effective stress controls frictional strength and deformation while water pressure also acts on an impermeable lining. Subtracting pore pressure from total stress therefore does not eliminate hydraulic loading on the lining. Temporary drawdown and long-term recovery require separate stages, with consistent stress directions and measurement depths. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：同一方向總應力 σ=900 kPa、孔壓 u=300 kPa，σ′=σ−u=600 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=900 kPa and pore pressure u=300 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=600 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效應力的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 開挖降低井壁側向拘束，土骨架與孔隙水卻不是同一條荷載路徑。有效應力決定摩擦強度及變形，水壓另對不透水襯砌施力；因此從總應力扣去孔壓後，不能在襯砌設計中再把水力作用刪除。
knowledge.textEn: Excavation removes lateral confinement, but the soil skeleton and pore water follow different load paths. Effective stress controls frictional strength and deformation while water pressure also acts on an impermeable lining.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「有效應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective stress mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。
開挖降低井壁側向拘束，土骨架與孔隙水卻不是同一條荷載路徑。
平均環向壓應力低於材料強度就不會產生裂縫。
optionsEn: A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored.
Excavation removes lateral confinement, but the soil skeleton and pore water follow different load paths.
A mean hoop stress below material strength prevents all cracking.
quiz.explanation: 開挖降低井壁側向拘束，土骨架與孔隙水卻不是同一條荷載路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Excavation removes lateral confinement, but the soil skeleton and pore water follow different load paths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效應力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective stress mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：同一方向總應力 σ=900 kPa、孔壓 u=300 kPa，σ′=σ−u=600 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=900 kPa and pore pressure u=300 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=600 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將分層水壓計與地質剖面對齊，先查高程基準及濾管所在含水層，再比較停抽前後孔壓。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align multilevel piezometers with the geological section, checking elevation datum and screened aquifer before comparing pressures before and after pumping stops.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：同一方向總應力 σ=900 kPa、孔壓 u=300 kPa，σ′=σ−u=600 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=900 kPa and pore pressure u=300 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=600 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效應力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective stress mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 最終襯砌足夠強就代表每個施工階段也足夠強。
降低混凝土最高溫就能完全消除早期拘束裂縫。
原創教學假設：同一方向總應力 σ=900 kPa、孔壓 u=300 kPa，σ′=σ−u=600 kPa。
optionsEn: Adequate completed-lining strength guarantees adequate strength at every construction stage.
Reducing peak concrete temperature alone eliminates all early restraint cracking.
Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=900 kPa and pore pressure u=300 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=600 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：同一方向總應力 σ=900 kPa、孔壓 u=300 kPa，σ′=σ−u=600 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=900 kPa and pore pressure u=300 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=600 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 有效應力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective stress mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將分層水壓計與地質剖面對齊，先查高程基準及濾管所在含水層，再比較停抽前後孔壓。以地層參數及施工階段推估骨架應力，分別保留總應力與有效應力欄，避免同名數值混用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align multilevel piezometers with the geological section, checking elevation datum and screened aquifer before comparing pressures before and after pumping stops. Infer skeleton stress using ground parameters and construction stage, retaining separate total and effective stress columns to prevent substitution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計圖應同時列出施工低水位、設計高水位與排水失效情境；襯砌封閉前，由地工與結構設計者共同確認各階段採用的水壓邊界。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Show construction drawdown, design high water and drainage failure on the design basis; before lining closure, the geotechnical and structural designers must jointly confirm hydraulic boundaries for each stage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把有效應力當成襯砌全部外壓，停抽後可能出現未預期裂縫及滲水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating effective stress as the entire lining pressure can produce unexpected cracking and leakage after pumping stops. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將分層水壓計與地質剖面對齊，先查高程基準及濾管所在含水層，再比較停抽前後孔壓。以地層參數及施工階段推估骨架應力，分別保留總應力與有效應力欄，避免同名數值混用。
knowledge.textEn: Align multilevel piezometers with the geological section, checking elevation datum and screened aquifer before comparing pressures before and after pumping stops. Infer skeleton stress using ground parameters and construction stage, retaining separate total and effective stress columns to prevent substitution.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計圖應同時列出施工低水位、設計高水位與排水失效情境；襯砌封閉前，由地工與結構設計者共同確認各階段採用的水壓邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Show construction drawdown, design high water and drainage failure on the design basis; before lining closure, the geotechnical and structural designers must jointly confirm hydraulic boundaries for each stage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「有效應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective stress mechanism and verification"?
options: 將分層水壓計與地質剖面對齊，先查高程基準及濾管所在含水層，再比較停抽前後孔壓。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
保護層只影響耐久性，不會影響截面內力與裂縫。
optionsEn: Align multilevel piezometers with the geological section, checking elevation datum and screened aquifer before comparing pressures before and after pumping stops.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Concrete cover affects durability but never section forces or cracking.
quiz.explanation: 將分層水壓計與地質剖面對齊，先查高程基準及濾管所在含水層，再比較停抽前後孔壓。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align multilevel piezometers with the geological section, checking elevation datum and screened aquifer before comparing pressures before and after pumping stops. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 有效應力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective stress mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把有效應力當成襯砌全部外壓，停抽後可能出現未預期裂縫及滲水。水位回升而井內仍乾燥時，壓差會增大，排水暢通的施工觀察不足以證明永久水密安全。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating effective stress as the entire lining pressure can produce unexpected cracking and leakage after pumping stops. Rising external water levels increase differential pressure around a dry shaft; successful construction drainage does not establish permanent watertightness. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工抽水與長期回復需分成不同階段，並核對應力方向及量測深度是否一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Temporary drawdown and long-term recovery require separate stages, with consistent stress directions and measurement depths.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把有效應力當成襯砌全部外壓，停抽後可能出現未預期裂縫及滲水。水位回升而井內仍乾燥時，壓差會增大，排水暢通的施工觀察不足以證明永久水密安全。
knowledge.textEn: Treating effective stress as the entire lining pressure can produce unexpected cracking and leakage after pumping stops. Rising external water levels increase differential pressure around a dry shaft; successful construction drainage does not establish permanent watertightness.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「有效應力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective stress mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把有效應力當成襯砌全部外壓，停抽後可能出現未預期裂縫及滲水。
平均環向壓應力低於材料強度就不會產生裂縫。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating effective stress as the entire lining pressure can produce unexpected cracking and leakage after pumping stops.
A mean hoop stress below material strength prevents all cracking.
quiz.explanation: 若把有效應力當成襯砌全部外壓，停抽後可能出現未預期裂縫及滲水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating effective stress as the entire lining pressure can produce unexpected cracking and leakage after pumping stops. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環向壓力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hoop compression mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環向壓力」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圓形襯砌可把近似均勻徑向外壓轉成環向壓力，這是圓井結構效率的來源。薄環模型假設厚度相對半徑小、斷面圓整且受壓連續；局部井口、設備孔洞或不均勻岩壓會破壞此假設。環向壓力只能描述平均膜力，不能替代偏心、裂縫、接縫轉動與局部彎矩的檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環向壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A circular lining converts approximately uniform radial pressure into hoop compression, explaining the efficiency of a round shaft. The thin-ring model assumes a relatively small thickness, a circular section and continuous compression. Openings, penetrations and nonuniform rock loading violate these assumptions. Hoop force describes average membrane action, but it cannot replace checks of eccentricity, cracking, joint rotation or local bending where the load path is interrupted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 環向壓力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hoop compression mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環向壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：外壓 p=0.4 MPa、半徑 R=4 m、厚度 t=0.5 m，N=pR=1.6 MN/m，平均 σ=N/t=3.2 MPa；本厚徑比須再以厚壁或數值模型檢查。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: With p=0.4 MPa, R=4 m and t=0.5 m, N=pR=1.6 MN/m and mean σ=N/t=3.2 MPa; this thickness ratio also requires a thick-wall or numerical check. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用全站儀或掃描取得井徑與橢圓度，將實測斷面放回環分析；對孔洞兩側及地層轉換處配置成對應變計，比較內外表面的差值，判別平均壓力以外的彎曲是否正在增加。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey diameter and ovality and insert the measured section into ring analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 環向壓力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hoop compression mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環向壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hoop compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用全站儀或掃描取得井徑與橢圓度，將實測斷面放回環分析；對孔洞兩側及地層轉換處配置成對應變計，比較內外表面的差值，判別平均壓力以外的彎曲是否正在增加。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey diameter and ovality and insert the measured section into ring analysis. Use paired strain gauges across openings and geological transitions; differences between inner and outer surface readings distinguish increasing local bending from average membrane compression. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將圓整度偏差、洞口加勁與背填驗收列為同一設計檢查；任何設備開孔變更，須經結構設計者確認環向力如何繞過開口後才施工。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Review ovality tolerances, opening reinforcement and backfill acceptance together; any revised service penetration requires the structural designer to confirm how hoop force bypasses the opening before construction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：偏心外壓或背填不實使圓環局部受彎，平均壓應力低仍可能在內緣形成拉裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Eccentric pressure or incomplete backfill bends the ring locally, allowing inner-face tension even at low mean compressive stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環向壓力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hoop compression mechanism and verification"?

steps.title: 環向壓力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hoop compression mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環向壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 偏心外壓或背填不實使圓環局部受彎，平均壓應力低仍可能在內緣形成拉裂。裂縫集中於開口角隅時，應追查力流中斷，不能只靠提高混凝土抗壓強度處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Eccentric pressure or incomplete backfill bends the ring locally, allowing inner-face tension even at low mean compressive stress. Cracks concentrated at opening corners indicate interrupted load paths that stronger concrete alone will not resolve. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：環向壓力只能描述平均膜力，不能替代偏心、裂縫、接縫轉動與局部彎矩的檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hoop force describes average membrane action, but it cannot replace checks of eccentricity, cracking, joint rotation or local bending where the load path is interrupted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均環向壓應力低於材料強度就不會產生裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 偏心外壓或背填不實使圓環局部受彎，平均壓應力低仍可能在內緣形成拉裂。裂縫集中於開口角隅時，應追查力流中斷，不能只靠提高混凝土抗壓強度處理。

quiz.question: 在「環向壓力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hoop compression mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「厚壁內緣的機理與驗證」與「分段自重的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thick-wall inner face mechanism and verification" and "Lift self-weight mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 厚壁內緣的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thick-wall inner face mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「厚壁內緣」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thick-wall inner face” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 襯砌較厚時，環向應力沿半徑並不均勻；以整個厚度平均值評估內緣會漏掉應力集中。拉梅解把內外表面的徑向壓力邊界同時納入，適用於均質彈性圓筒的軸對稱狀態。分塊接縫、開裂及非均勻地層作用會改變剛度與接觸，須另用含接縫的模型判讀，不能把解析解當成完整承載能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「厚壁內緣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a thick lining, hoop stress varies across the radius, so an average stress can miss the inner-face concentration. The Lamé solution enforces radial-pressure boundaries at both surfaces and applies to a homogeneous elastic cylinder under axisymmetric loading. Segment joints, cracking and uneven ground alter stiffness and contact. They require separate joint-sensitive analysis; the elastic solution estimates a stress distribution rather than a complete structural resistance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thick-wall inner face” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：內半徑 a=4 m、外半徑 b=5 m、均勻外壓 p=0.4 MPa且內壓為零，σθ(a)=−2pb²/(b²−a²)=−2.22 MPa，負號代表受壓。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For a=4 m, b=5 m, external p=0.4 MPa and zero internal pressure, σθ(a)=−2pb²/(b²−a²)=−2.22 MPa, with compression negative.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最終襯砌足夠強就代表每個施工階段也足夠強。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate completed-lining strength guarantees adequate strength at every construction stage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 施工縫止水的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Construction-joint waterstop mechanism and verification: testing and verification

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Construction-joint waterstop” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查止水帶接頭連續性、固定位置與澆置後的蜂窩區；以代表性接縫試體在指定開口與錯位下施加水壓。比較滲漏量與專案訂定標準，並記錄升降壓循環後是否留下永久變形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect splice continuity, restraint position and honeycombing. Test a representative joint under specified opening and offset while applying water pressure; compare leakage with project criteria and record permanent deformation after pressure cycles rather than testing an undeformed strip alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將接頭照片、材料批號與接縫位移需求綁定同一位置編碼；封模前由監造確認止水連續性，缺陷處理須經設計者核准而非只增塗表面材料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Link splice photographs, material batch and required joint movement to one location code; inspection must confirm continuity before form closure, and the designer must approve defect repair rather than relying on added surface coating.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：止水帶扭轉、斷接或周邊蜂窩會形成繞流，常見症狀是施工縫局部出水而本體仍乾。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Twisting, discontinuous splices or surrounding honeycombing create bypass paths, often producing localized joint leakage while the concrete remains dry. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工縫止水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction-joint waterstop” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 止水帶扭轉、斷接或周邊蜂窩會形成繞流，常見症狀是施工縫局部出水而本體仍乾。只在內表面封堵可能使水改走另一弱面，並掩蓋持續外水壓。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Twisting, discontinuous splices or surrounding honeycombing create bypass paths, often producing localized joint leakage while the concrete remains dry. Surface sealing alone may divert flow to another weak interface and conceal sustained external water pressure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接縫張開、錯位與材料老化會影響止水能力，故不能把混凝土本體抗滲結果直接當作施工縫性能，必須把位移與水壓共同納入試驗邊界。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Concrete permeability alone therefore does not establish joint performance; displacement and water pressure must be imposed together when defining a representative qualification test.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「止水材料耐水壓合格就表示整條施工縫一定水密。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A waterstop material pressure rating guarantees a watertight constructed joint." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objective: 說明「早齡期溫差」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Early-age temperature change” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水化熱提高厚襯砌核心溫度，後續降溫卻受到先澆段及岩面的拘束，於是自由收縮轉變為拉應力。材料在早齡期的彈性模數、抗拉強度與潛變都隨時間改變，完全拘束的彈性式僅提供上限量級。把溫差與齡期分開看會漏掉最弱時刻，因此須同時記錄溫度歷程、養護條件及接縫拘束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「早齡期溫差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydration heats the lining core, but subsequent cooling is restrained by earlier lifts and the rock, converting free contraction into tension. Elastic modulus, tensile strength and creep all change at early age, so a fully restrained elastic expression is only a bounding scale. Temperature difference cannot be assessed independently of material age: the weakest stage requires simultaneous temperature histories, curing conditions and realistic joint restraint rather than a final concrete strength alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Early-age temperature change” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設完全拘束、E=20 GPa、α=1×10⁻⁵/K、降溫ΔT=15 K，σ=EαΔT=3 MPa；未含潛變鬆弛。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Assuming full restraint, E=20 GPa, α=1×10⁻⁵/K and cooling ΔT=15 K, σ=EαΔT=3 MPa; creep relaxation is excluded.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「降低混凝土最高溫就能完全消除早期拘束裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing peak concrete temperature alone eliminates all early restraint cracking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「早齡期溫差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 早齡期溫差的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Early-age temperature change mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「早齡期溫差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Early-age temperature change” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過快表面降溫或強拘束會產生貫穿裂縫，之後外水壓沿裂縫作用。若只把裂縫當成一般乾縮，忽略水化熱時程，後續各施工段可能重複出現相同損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid surface cooling or strong restraint can cause through-cracks that later admit pressurized water. Misclassifying these as ordinary drying shrinkage and ignoring the hydration history can reproduce the same damage in subsequent lining lifts. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把溫差與齡期分開看會漏掉最弱時刻，因此須同時記錄溫度歷程、養護條件及接縫拘束。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Temperature difference cannot be assessed independently of material age: the weakest stage requires simultaneous temperature histories, curing conditions and realistic joint restraint rather than a final concrete strength alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「降低混凝土最高溫就能完全消除早期拘束裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing peak concrete temperature alone eliminates all early restraint cracking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

quiz.question: 在「早齡期溫差的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「背填空隙的機理與驗證」與「鋼筋保護層的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Backfill void mechanism and verification" and "Reinforcement cover mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 背填空隙的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Backfill void mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「背填空隙」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backfill void” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 襯砌外側背填的功能是建立地層與圓環之間的接觸，空隙會讓原本分散的徑向作用集中到空隙兩端。局部襯砌此時近似跨越缺口的板帶，彎曲需求隨未支承長度平方增長。簡支梁只是診斷用量級，真實曲率、軸向壓力與兩側彈性支承會改變結果，灌漿壓力本身也可能額外推動襯砌。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「背填空隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill establishes contact between the ground and lining; a void concentrates formerly distributed radial loading near its edges. The local lining behaves partly like a strip spanning a gap, with bending increasing approximately with the square of unsupported length. A simply supported beam is a diagnostic scale only: curvature, hoop compression and elastic end restraint change the response, while backfill pressure can itself impose additional lining movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backfill void” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單位寬板帶均布載重 w=40 kN/m、假設簡支缺口 L=2 m，M=wL²/8=20 kN·m/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For a unit-width strip with w=40 kN/m and a hypothetical simply supported gap L=2 m, M=wL²/8=20 kN·m per metre of lining width.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「灌入的漿量越多就代表襯砌外側接觸越完整。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More injected grout necessarily means more complete lining contact." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「背填空隙」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Backfill void”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 背填空隙的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 襯砌外側背填的功能是建立地層與圓環之間的接觸，空隙會讓原本分散的徑向作用集中到空隙兩端。局部襯砌此時近似跨越缺口的板帶，彎曲需求隨未支承長度平方增長。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：灌入的漿量越多就代表襯砌外側接觸越完整。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More injected grout necessarily means more complete lining contact. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「背填空隙的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Backfill void mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 灌入的漿量越多就代表襯砌外側接觸越完整。

optionsEn: More injected grout necessarily means more complete lining contact.

steps.title: 背填空隙的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Backfill void mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背填空隙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backfill void” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單位寬板帶均布載重 w=40 kN/m、假設簡支缺口 L=2 m，M=wL²/8=20 kN·m/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For a unit-width strip with w=40 kN/m and a hypothetical simply supported gap L=2 m, M=wL²/8=20 kN·m per metre of lining width. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以背填量平衡、聲學檢測及必要的驗證孔交叉定位空隙，避免僅用灌漿耗量推定填滿。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Locate voids using backfill-volume balance, acoustic methods and justified verification holes rather than grout consumption alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：單位寬板帶均布載重 w=40 kN/m、假設簡支缺口 L=2 m，M=wL²/8=20 kN·m/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For a unit-width strip with w=40 kN/m and a hypothetical simply supported gap L=2 m, M=wL²/8=20 kN·m per metre of lining width. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「背填空隙的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Backfill void mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 裂縫寬度未超過某個固定數值就永遠不必追查。

A mean hoop stress below material strength prevents all cracking.

steps.title: 背填空隙的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「背填空隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backfill void” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以背填量平衡、聲學檢測及必要的驗證孔交叉定位空隙，避免僅用灌漿耗量推定填滿。將疑似空隙長度與裂縫位置疊圖，再比較補填前後的應變及接觸狀況，確認力流已恢復。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Locate voids using backfill-volume balance, acoustic methods and justified verification holes rather than grout consumption alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：背填驗收應以可證明的接觸範圍及結構反應為主；異常耗漿或襯砌位移須觸發停留點，由地工與襯砌設計者共同審查補填方案。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：空隙兩端可能先出現彎曲裂縫，過高補漿壓力又可能把裂縫撐大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Bending cracks can develop at void edges, while excessive remedial grouting pressure may widen them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Locate voids using backfill-volume balance, acoustic methods and justified verification holes rather than grout consumption alone. Overlay suspected void length and cracking, then compare strain and contact evidence before and after remedial filling to verify restoration of the load path.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 背填驗收應以可證明的接觸範圍及結構反應為主；異常耗漿或襯砌位移須觸發停留點，由地工與襯砌設計者共同審查補填方案。
knowledge.textEn: Base backfill acceptance on demonstrable contact extent and structural response; abnormal grout consumption or lining movement triggers a hold point for joint review by the geotechnical and lining designers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「背填空隙的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Backfill void mechanism and verification"?
options: 以背填量平衡、聲學檢測及必要的驗證孔交叉定位空隙，避免僅用灌漿耗量推定填滿。

options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。
保護層過薄可能加速腐蝕，過厚又可能降低力臂並形成較寬表面裂縫。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released.
Thin cover can accelerate corrosion, while excessive cover reduces lever arm and may widen surface cracks.
quiz.explanation: 保護層過薄可能加速腐蝕，過厚又可能降低力臂並形成較寬表面裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Thin cover can accelerate corrosion, while excessive cover reduces lever arm and may widen surface cracks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水頭回復的機理與驗證」與「裂縫成長率的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification" and "Crack growth rate mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水頭回復的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水頭回復」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Groundwater recovery” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停抽後含水層的水頭逐步回復，襯砌的永久荷載可能高於施工期間，且不同含水層的回復速率未必相同。若永久設計依賴排水，堵塞、停電及管路隔離就屬重要的失效情境。監測必須區分外部水頭與井內水位，因為作用於襯砌的是兩側壓差，單看抽水機是否運轉無法證明壓差受到控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水頭回復」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After pumping stops, aquifer heads recover and permanent lining loads may exceed construction loads; separate aquifers need not recover at the same rate. If the permanent design relies on drainage, blockage, power loss and pipe isolation become relevant failure scenarios. Monitoring must distinguish external head from the internal shaft water level because differential pressure loads the lining. Pump-running status alone does not establish control of that pressure difference. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Groundwater recovery” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：外部水頭增加 Δh=20 m、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²且內水位不變，Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For external recovery Δh=20 m, ρ=1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and unchanged internal level, Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水頭回復」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Groundwater recovery”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水頭回復的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 停抽後含水層的水頭逐步回復，襯砌的永久荷載可能高於施工期間，且不同含水層的回復速率未必相同。若永久設計依賴排水，堵塞、停電及管路隔離就屬重要的失效情境。
knowledge.textEn: After pumping stops, aquifer heads recover and permanent lining loads may exceed construction loads; separate aquifers need not recover at the same rate. If the permanent design relies on drainage, blockage, power loss and pipe isolation become relevant failure scenarios.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水頭回復的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 停抽後含水層的水頭逐步回復，襯砌的永久荷載可能高於施工期間，且不同含水層的回復速率未必相同。
有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。
裂縫寬度未超過某個固定數值就永遠不必追查。
optionsEn: After pumping stops, aquifer heads recover and permanent lining loads may exceed construction loads; separate aquifers need not recover at the same rate.
Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released.
A crack below one fixed width never needs further investigation.
quiz.explanation: 停抽後含水層的水頭逐步回復，襯砌的永久荷載可能高於施工期間，且不同含水層的回復速率未必相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After pumping stops, aquifer heads recover and permanent lining loads may exceed construction loads; separate aquifers need not recover at the same rate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水頭回復的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水頭回復」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Groundwater recovery” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：外部水頭增加 Δh=20 m、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²且內水位不變，Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For external recovery Δh=20 m, ρ=1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and unchanged internal level, Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每個水壓計記錄所在含水層與設計水頭，建立停抽後趨勢圖；同步比較排水量、裂縫與滲漏位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Assign each piezometer to an aquifer and design head, then trend pressures after pumping stops.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：外部水頭增加 Δh=20 m、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²且內水位不變，Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For external recovery Δh=20 m, ρ=1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and unchanged internal level, Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水頭回復的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 平均環向壓應力低於材料強度就不會產生裂縫。
原創教學假設：外部水頭增加 Δh=20 m、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²且內水位不變，Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa。
最終襯砌足夠強就代表每個施工階段也足夠強。
optionsEn: A mean hoop stress below material strength prevents all cracking.
Original teaching assumptions: For external recovery Δh=20 m, ρ=1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and unchanged internal level, Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa.
Adequate completed-lining strength guarantees adequate strength at every construction stage.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：外部水頭增加 Δh=20 m、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²且內水位不變，Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For external recovery Δh=20 m, ρ=1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and unchanged internal level, Δp=ρgΔh=196200 Pa=196 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水頭回復的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水頭回復」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Groundwater recovery” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對每個水壓計記錄所在含水層與設計水頭，建立停抽後趨勢圖；同步比較排水量、裂縫與滲漏位置。只有壓差與結構反應均落在核定範圍，才可確認交接階段的水力邊界成立。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Assign each piezometer to an aquifer and design head, then trend pressures after pumping stops. Compare drainage flow, crack readings and leak locations concurrently; the handover hydraulic boundary is demonstrated only when pressure differences and structural response satisfy approved criteria. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護圖應標明每段排水的集水範圍、可隔離閥及替代排水路徑；停抽或封閉排水前，由設計者及營運單位共同核准水頭回復監測計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Maintenance drawings must identify each drainage catchment, isolation valve and alternative route; the designer and operator jointly approve a groundwater-recovery monitoring plan before pumping or drainage is discontinued.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排水管沉積或閥門誤關可能使外壓快速上升，而泵房狀態仍顯示正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sediment or an incorrectly closed valve can raise external pressure while the pump-room display appears normal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對每個水壓計記錄所在含水層與設計水頭，建立停抽後趨勢圖；同步比較排水量、裂縫與滲漏位置。只有壓差與結構反應均落在核定範圍，才可確認交接階段的水力邊界成立。
knowledge.textEn: Assign each piezometer to an aquifer and design head, then trend pressures after pumping stops. Compare drainage flow, crack readings and leak locations concurrently; the handover hydraulic boundary is demonstrated only when pressure differences and structural response satisfy approved criteria.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護圖應標明每段排水的集水範圍、可隔離閥及替代排水路徑；停抽或封閉排水前，由設計者及營運單位共同核准水頭回復監測計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Maintenance drawings must identify each drainage catchment, isolation valve and alternative route; the designer and operator jointly approve a groundwater-recovery monitoring plan before pumping or drainage is discontinued.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水頭回復的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
降低混凝土最高溫就能完全消除早期拘束裂縫。
對每個水壓計記錄所在含水層與設計水頭，建立停抽後趨勢圖；同步比較排水量、裂縫與滲漏位置。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Reducing peak concrete temperature alone eliminates all early restraint cracking.
Assign each piezometer to an aquifer and design head, then trend pressures after pumping stops.
quiz.explanation: 對每個水壓計記錄所在含水層與設計水頭，建立停抽後趨勢圖；同步比較排水量、裂縫與滲漏位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Assign each piezometer to an aquifer and design head, then trend pressures after pumping stops. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水頭回復的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水頭回復」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Groundwater recovery” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水管沉積或閥門誤關可能使外壓快速上升，而泵房狀態仍顯示正常。先出現接縫滲漏不表示壓力已安全釋放，局部堵塞與壓力分區可能仍持續增加構件需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sediment or an incorrectly closed valve can raise external pressure while the pump-room display appears normal. Initial joint leakage does not prove safe pressure relief; local blockage and compartmentalized water can continue increasing lining demand. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：監測必須區分外部水頭與井內水位，因為作用於襯砌的是兩側壓差，單看抽水機是否運轉無法證明壓差受到控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pump-running status alone does not establish control of that pressure difference.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「有滲水就代表外部水壓已經全部釋放。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Visible leakage proves that all external water pressure has been released." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 排水管沉積或閥門誤關可能使外壓快速上升，而泵房狀態仍顯示正常。先出現接縫滲漏不表示壓力已安全釋放，局部堵塞與壓力分區可能仍持續增加構件需求。
knowledge.textEn: Sediment or an incorrectly closed valve can raise external pressure while the pump-room display appears normal. Initial joint leakage does not prove safe pressure relief; local blockage and compartmentalized water can continue increasing lining demand.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水頭回復的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Groundwater recovery mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 排水管沉積或閥門誤關可能使外壓快速上升，而泵房狀態仍顯示正常。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
裂縫寬度未超過某個固定數值就永遠不必追查。
optionsEn: Sediment or an incorrectly closed valve can raise external pressure while the pump-room display appears normal.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A crack below one fixed width never needs further investigation.
quiz.explanation: 排水管沉積或閥門誤關可能使外壓快速上升，而泵房狀態仍顯示正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sediment or an incorrectly closed valve can raise external pressure while the pump-room display appears normal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 裂縫成長率的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crack growth rate mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂縫成長率」如何影響深豎井襯砌施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crack growth rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-shaft lining construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裂縫寬度是某一時刻的狀態，成長率與其對溫度及水頭的反應才有助區分持續變形和可逆開合。相同裂縫在不同季節量測可能有不同寬度，測點位置改變也會造成假趨勢。維護判讀需把裂縫位置、方向、滲水與材料劣化放在同一時間軸，避免把平穩表象誤認為已停止發展。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂縫成長率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crack width describes one state, while growth rate and response to temperature and water head help distinguish progressive deformation from reversible opening. Seasonal measurements can differ even without permanent damage, and changing gauge locations creates false trends. Maintenance interpretation therefore needs a common time axis for crack position, direction, leakage and material deterioration. An apparently stable isolated reading does not establish that the underlying movement has stopped. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crack growth rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：固定測點裂縫由 w₀=0.20 mm增至w₁=0.30 mm，間隔Δt=2 year，平均成長率(w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: At a fixed point, width changes from w₀=0.20 mm to w₁=0.30 mm over Δt=2 year, giving mean growth (w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year.

knowledge.title: 裂縫成長率的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Crack growth rate mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 裂縫寬度是某一時刻的狀態，成長率與其對溫度及水頭的反應才有助區分持續變形和可逆開合。相同裂縫在不同季節量測可能有不同寬度，測點位置改變也會造成假趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: Crack width describes one state, while growth rate and response to temperature and water head help distinguish progressive deformation from reversible opening. Seasonal measurements can differ even without permanent damage, and changing gauge locations creates false trends.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：裂縫寬度未超過某個固定數值就永遠不必追查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A crack below one fixed width never needs further investigation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「裂縫成長率的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crack growth rate mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 裂縫寬度未超過某個固定數值就永遠不必追查。
裂縫寬度是某一時刻的狀態，成長率與其對溫度及水頭的反應才有助區分持續變形和可逆開合。
抽水期間井壁乾燥就表示永久水壓可以忽略。
optionsEn: A crack below one fixed width never needs further investigation.
Crack width describes one state, while growth rate and response to temperature and water head help distinguish progressive deformation from reversible opening.
A dry shaft during pumping means permanent water pressure can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 裂縫寬度是某一時刻的狀態，成長率與其對溫度及水頭的反應才有助區分持續變形和可逆開合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Crack width describes one state, while growth rate and response to temperature and water head help distinguish progressive deformation from reversible opening. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裂縫成長率的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crack growth rate mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂縫成長率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crack growth rate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：固定測點裂縫由 w₀=0.20 mm增至w₁=0.30 mm，間隔Δt=2 year，平均成長率(w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: At a fixed point, width changes from w₀=0.20 mm to w₁=0.30 mm over Δt=2 year, giving mean growth (w₁−w₀)/Δt=0.05 mm/year. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用固定基座裂縫計與可重複照片定位，紀錄每次讀值的溫度、水頭及儀器解析度；比較同條件下的永久增量與短期循環。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use fixed-base crack gauges and repeatable photographs, recording temperature, head and instrument resolution with every reading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 裂縫成長率的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crack growth rate mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂縫成長率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crack growth rate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用固定基座裂縫計與可重複照片定位，紀錄每次讀值的溫度、水頭及儀器解析度；比較同條件下的永久增量與短期循環。當變化接近解析度時先報不確定度，避免把量測雜訊當成劣化趨勢。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use fixed-base crack gauges and repeatable photographs, recording temperature, head and instrument resolution with every reading. Separate permanent increments at comparable conditions from short cycles; report uncertainty when changes approach resolution rather than treating noise as deterioration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接資料應含初始裂縫圖、環境基準與事件後檢查責任；異常成長或滲流改變由管理單位召集原設計專業判讀，不能只以年度平均率決定放行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover must include initial crack maps, environmental baselines and responsibility for post-event inspections; abnormal growth or changed seepage requires engineering interpretation, and annual mean growth alone must not determine release.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：缺少固定基準或忽略溫度會造成錯誤警報，也可能把緩慢劣化抵銷成無變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unstable reference points or uncorrected temperature can create false alarms or hide slow deterioration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 裂縫成長率的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crack growth rate mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂縫成長率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crack growth rate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 缺少固定基準或忽略溫度會造成錯誤警報，也可能把緩慢劣化抵銷成無變化。若裂縫伴隨混濁滲水或新剝落，應追查接觸、滲流與腐蝕，而非僅重貼量測標記。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unstable reference points or uncorrected temperature can create false alarms or hide slow deterioration. Cracking accompanied by turbid leakage or fresh spalling requires investigation of contact, seepage and corrosion rather than merely replacing measurement marks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：維護判讀需把裂縫位置、方向、滲水與材料劣化放在同一時間軸，避免把平穩表象誤認為已停止發展。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裂縫寬度未超過某個固定數值就永遠不必追查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

quiz.question: 在「裂縫成長率的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
